notes.title: Beta 1.0b
notes.notes:
The following changes and additions have been made in 1.0b:

- Turkish language added to menu

- Several new images in the window

- Several new objects

- Two new achievements

- Fix minor bugs

notes.title: Beta 1.0a

notes.title: Beta 1.0 has been released!
notes.notes: I am glad to announce that Poopy Philosophy is on Steam. At the moment, the game is in beta test, many ideas have not yet been implemented, a lot of things have to be added and improved. Play the game, share your emotions, suggestions and interesting ideas. The next update for the game will be released on November 27, the new update will introduce new endings, achievements, customization and much more!
